chapter_en: Chapter 35: An audience with the sovereign

units.chapter_en: Chapter 35: An audience with the sovereign
units.title: 朝天面旨：以太岁五爻为主、官鬼世象为凭；面君官旺世无伤折槛廷诤也不妨，太岁五爻冲克世休趋殿陛惹天殃；面君者先推世象次察官爻，二爻旺相不空又不受君爻冲克则并无玷剥，世爻若被天子之爻冲克朝必遭殃守静为上

rule.yi: 朝见君王，以太岁和五爻为主，以官鬼、世爻为凭据。面君时官爻旺相、世爻没有受伤，就是折断栏杆、在朝廷上直言力谏也无妨；太岁、五爻如果冲克世爻，就不要趋步到殿前去招来天灾。面君的人，先推世爻，再察官爻：这两爻如果旺相、不落空亡，又不受君王之爻冲克，去见天子就没有污损伤害；世爻如果被天子之爻冲克，上朝一定遭殃，以安静守着为上。
rule.en: For an audience with the sovereign, take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief, and Pressure and the Self image as the ground. If the star of office is thriving and the Self is unhurt, even breaking the balustrade in a remonstrance at court is no matter; if Tai Sui or the fifth line clashes with or controls the Self, do not hasten to the palace steps to bring on a heavenly calamity. One who is to see the sovereign should first reckon the Self image and then examine the Pressure line: if these two lines are thriving, not on Void, and not clashed or controlled by the sovereign's line, then going before the Son of Heaven there will be no blemish or harm; if the Self line is clashed or controlled by the Son of Heaven's line, going to court will surely bring calamity, and keeping quiet is best.

zh: 以太岁五爻为主，官鬼世象为凭。
yi: 以太岁、五爻为主要看的，以官鬼、世爻为凭据。
en: Take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 面君官旺世无伤，折槛廷诤也不妨，
太岁五爻冲克世，休趋殿陛惹天殃。
yi: 面见君王，官爻旺相、世爻没有受伤，就是折断栏杆在朝廷上直言力谏也无妨；
太岁、五爻冲克世爻，就不要趋步到殿前去招来天灾。
en: In an audience with the sovereign, if the star of office is thriving and the Self is unhurt, even breaking the balustrade in a remonstrance at court is no matter;
if Tai Sui or the fifth line clashes with or controls the Self, do not hasten to the palace steps to bring on a heavenly calamity.

zh: 面君者，先推世象，次察官爻，此二爻如临旺相，不值空亡，又不受君爻冲克，在去天天并无玷剥。
世爻若被天子之爻冲克者，朝必遭殃，守静为上。
yi: 面君的人，先推世爻，再察官爻；这两爻如果旺相、不落空亡，又不受君王之爻冲克，去见天子就没有污损、伤害。
世爻如果被天子之爻冲克，上朝一定遭殃，以安静守着为上。
en: One who is to see the sovereign should first reckon the Self image and then examine the Pressure line; if these two lines are thriving, not on Void, and not clashed or controlled by the sovereign's line, then going before the Son of Heaven there will be no blemish or harm.
If the Self line is clashed or controlled by the Son of Heaven's line, going to court will surely bring calamity, and keeping quiet is best.

note.yi: 「折槛」用的是汉朝朱云在殿上直谏、攀折殿槛（栏杆）的典故；「廷诤」是在朝廷上直言劝谏；「殿陛」是宫殿的台阶。「在去天天并无玷剥」文字有误，疑是「此去天颜并无玷剥」，译作「去见天子就没有污损、伤害」。「君爻」是五爻（天子之爻）。「守静」是不去、不动。这一条与增删卜易上书「子动临身，力能折槛」（ZS.33）同用「折槛」一典，但那一条看的是子孙，这里看官爻和世爻。
note.en: 'Zhe jian' alludes to Zhu Yun of the Han, who remonstrated in the hall and clung to the balustrade until it broke; 'tingzheng' is remonstrating plainly at court; 'dianbi' are the steps of the palace. 'Zai qu tian tian bing wu dian bo' is corrupt in its characters and is presumably 'ci qu tianyan bing wu dian bo', translated 'going before the Son of Heaven there will be no blemish or harm'. 'Junyao', the sovereign's line, is the fifth line (the line of the Son of Heaven). 'Shoujing' is not going and not acting. This entry uses the same allusion of 'breaking the balustrade' as 'if Output moves on the Body, one has the strength to break the balustrade' in the Zengshan Buyi on submitting letters (ZS.33), but that entry looks at Output and this one looks at the Pressure line and the Self.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 35: An audience with the sovereign
units.title: 朝天面旨：日辰月建生身吉、克世伤官尽不祥，卦值晋升蒙上宠、爻成屯蹇岂为强；世爻与官爻纵值休囚得日月或动爻生助或变出生扶皆为佳兆，朝王卜得火地晋、地风升皆吉，水雷屯、水山蹇皆为难遇者必凶

rule.yi: 日辰、月建生助身爻是吉，克世爻、伤官爻就都不祥；卦遇晋、升，蒙受君上的恩宠；爻成屯、蹇，哪里谈得上强？世爻和官爻即使逢休囚，只要得到日月或动爻生助，或者变出生扶它们的爻，都是好兆；如果动爻和日月伤官爻、伤世爻，都按凶来推。朝见君王卜得火地晋，晋是臣子遇见君王的象；又取地风升，升是往前、往上走，所以这两卦都吉；如果卜得水雷屯、水山蹇两卦，都是艰难，遇到的一定凶。
rule.en: If the Day and the Month generate the Body it is auspicious; if they control the Self or hurt the star of office, all is inauspicious. If the hexagram is Jin or Sheng, one receives the sovereign's favour; if the lines make Zhun or Jian, how could it be strong? Even if the Self line and the Pressure line are resting or imprisoned, if they get generation and aid from the Day and the Month or a moving line, or change out a line that generates and supports them, it is all a good omen; if a moving line and the Day and Month hurt the star of office or the Self, all is judged ominous. If in going to see the king one casts Jin, Fire over Earth, Jin is the image of a minister meeting his sovereign; Sheng, Earth over Wind, is also taken, for Sheng is advancing and going up, so these two hexagrams are both auspicious. If one casts Zhun, Water over Thunder, or Jian, Water over Mountain, both mean difficulty, and whoever meets them will surely have ill.

zh: 日辰月建生身吉，克世伤官尽不祥，
卦值晋升蒙上宠，爻成屯蹇岂为强。
yi: 日辰、月建生助身爻是吉，克世爻、伤官爻就都不祥；
卦遇晋、升，蒙受君上的恩宠；爻成屯、蹇，哪里谈得上强？
en: If the Day and the Month generate the Body it is auspicious; if they control the Self or hurt the star of office, all is inauspicious;
if the hexagram is Jin or Sheng, one receives the sovereign's favour; if the lines make Zhun or Jian, how could it be strong?

zh: 世爻与官爻纵值休囚，得日月或动爻生助、或变出生扶，皆为佳兆，若动爻与日月伤官伤世，俱作凶推，朝王卜得火地晋，晋者以臣遇君之象。
又取地风升，升者，进而上也，故此二卦皆吉。
若卜水雷屯、水山蹇二卦，皆为难也，遇者必凶。
yi: 世爻和官爻即使逢休囚，得到日月或动爻生助，或者变出生扶它们的爻，都是好兆；如果动爻和日月伤官爻、伤世爻，都按凶来推。朝见君王卜得火地晋，晋是臣子遇见君王的象。
又取地风升，升是往前、往上走，所以这两卦都吉。
如果卜得水雷屯、水山蹇两卦，都是艰难，遇到的一定凶。
en: Even if the Self line and the Pressure line are resting or imprisoned, if they get generation and aid from the Day and the Month or a moving line, or change out a line that generates and supports them, it is all a good omen; if a moving line and the Day and Month hurt the star of office or the Self, all is judged ominous. If in going to see the king one casts Jin, Fire over Earth, Jin is the image of a minister meeting his sovereign.
Sheng, Earth over Wind, is also taken, for 'sheng' is advancing and going up, so these two hexagrams are both auspicious.
If one casts Zhun, Water over Thunder, or Jian, Water over Mountain, both mean difficulty, and whoever meets them will surely have ill.

dispute.yi: 这里说卜得屯、蹇两卦「皆为难也，遇者必凶」；增删卜易引了古人「晋、升为吉，屯、蹇为凶」的说法后，野鹤（ZS.07）说晋、升也要世爻得地，屯、蹇两卦只要世爻旺相就没有妨碍，他有一次世爻旺相占到屯卦，照样越级升迁。也就是说：这里把卦名当作断语，增删卜易把卦名放在世爻旺衰的后面。
dispute.en: This entry says that casting Zhun or Jian 'both mean difficulty, and whoever meets them will surely have ill'; the Zengshan Buyi quotes the ancients' 'Jin and Sheng are auspicious, Zhun and Jian ominous' and then the Old Man of Yehe (ZS.07) says that Jin and Sheng also need the Self to be well placed, that for Zhun and Jian there is no harm so long as the Self is thriving, and that once he got Zhun with a thriving Self and was promoted beyond rank all the same. That is, this entry takes the hexagram name as a verdict, while the Zengshan Buyi puts the hexagram name behind the strength of the Self.

note.yi: 「火地晋」「地风升」「水雷屯」「水山蹇」是《周易》的卦名，这里按卦名取义：晋是前进，升是上升，屯、蹇是艰难。解里先说世爻、官爻的旺衰生克，最后才说卦名。「休囚」见术语表。「动爻与日月伤官伤世」书里连写，这里按「动爻和日月来伤官爻、伤世爻」读。
note.en: 'Huo di Jin', 'Di feng Sheng', 'Shui lei Zhun' and 'Shui shan Jian' are hexagram names of the Book of Changes, taken here by the meaning of the name: Jin is advancing, Sheng is rising, Zhun and Jian are difficulty. The explanation first speaks of the strength, generation and control of the Self and Pressure and only afterwards of the hexagram names. 'Resting or imprisoned' is in the glossary. 'Dong yao yu ri yue shang guan shang shi' is run together in the book and is read here as 'a moving line and the Day and Month come to hurt the star of office and the Self'.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 35: An audience with the sovereign
units.title: 朝天面旨：逢冲莫去朝天子、遇合应来奏帝皇，无鬼不能沾雨露、世空岂得受恩光；六冲之象切莫朝天，六合之爻理宜面圣，爻虽攒合卦中无鬼或值空乡渥恩莫望，卦纵有官世居陷地还嗟运蹇岂沐天恩

rule.yi: 逢到冲，不要去朝见天子；遇到合，就该来奏对皇帝；没有官鬼，就沾不到雨露（恩泽）；世爻落空，怎能蒙受恩光？具体说：六冲的卦象，千万不要去朝见天子；六合的爻象，按理适宜面见圣上；爻象虽然聚合，但卦中没有官鬼，或者落在空乡，就不要指望丰厚的恩典；卦里即使有官爻，世爻落在陷地，也只能叹运气艰难，怎么谈得上沐浴天恩？
rule.en: Meeting a clash, do not go to court the Son of Heaven; meeting a combination, it is fitting to come and memorialise the emperor; with no Pressure one cannot share in the rain and dew of favour; with the Self Void how can one receive the glow of grace? In detail: with a six-clash image, on no account go to court; with a six-combine line, it is proper to meet the sage sovereign; even if the lines gather in combination, if the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on empty ground, do not hope for rich favour; even if the hexagram has a star of office, if the Self sits in a pit one can still only lament one's hard fortune, and how could one bathe in heaven's favour?

zh: 逢冲莫去朝天子，遇合应来奏帝皇，
无鬼不能沾雨露，世空岂得受恩光。
yi: 逢到冲，不要去朝见天子；遇到合，就该来奏对皇帝；
没有官鬼，就沾不到雨露（恩泽）；世爻落空，怎能蒙受恩光？
en: Meeting a clash, do not go to court the Son of Heaven; meeting a combination, it is fitting to come and memorialise the emperor;
with no Pressure one cannot share in the rain and dew of favour; with the Self Void how can one receive the glow of grace?

zh: 爻虽攒合，卦中无鬼或值空乡，渥恩莫望。
卦纵有官，世居陷地，还嗟运蹇，岂沐天恩。
yi: 六冲的卦象，千万不要去朝见天子。
六合的爻象，按理适宜面见圣上。
爻象虽然聚合，但卦中没有官鬼，或者落在空乡，就不要指望丰厚的恩典。
卦里即使有官爻，世爻落在陷地，也只能叹运气艰难，怎么谈得上沐浴天恩？
en: With a six-clash image, on no account go to court.
With a six-combine line, it is proper to meet the sage sovereign.
Even if the lines gather in combination, if the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on empty ground, do not hope for rich favour.
Even if the hexagram has a star of office, if the Self sits in a pit one can still only lament one's hard fortune, and how could one bathe in heaven's favour?

note.yi: 「六冲」「六合」指卦的六冲、六合（见术语表）。「攒合」是聚合，「空乡」是空亡之地，「渥恩」是优厚的恩典。「世居陷地」的「陷」与前面仕宦升迁「临陷临空」同，是落入空、墓、绝一类凶地，书里没有细说。这一条与黄金策仕宦「奏陈谏诤，那堪太岁刑冲」（HJC.26）取同一类忌：冲克是朝见君王的大忌。
note.en: 'Six-clash' and 'six-combine' are the hexagram patterns (see the glossary). 'Cuanhe' is gathering in combination, 'kongxiang' is the ground of Void, and 'wo'en' is rich favour. The 'xian' of 'shi ju xian di' is the same as in 'lin xian lin kong' in the earlier chapter on official promotion, a fall into a bad place such as Void, tomb or extinction, and the book does not go into it. This entry takes the same taboo as 'for memorials and remonstrance, how can one bear Tai Sui's punishment and clash' in the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.26): clash and control are the great taboo for seeing the sovereign.
